# apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code (Resource)

Creates a custom code, such as `SPRING26`, that customers enter to redeem a subscription offer code. Changing it creates a new one. App Store Connect can't delete codes, so destroying the resource deactivates them. Import it with `<offer_code_id>/<id>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code" "spring" {
  offer_code_id   = apple_subscription_offer_code.spring.id
  custom_code     = "SPRING26"
  number_of_codes = 1000
  expiration_date = "2026-06-30"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `custom_code` (String) Code customers enter, e.g. `SPRING26`; unique among the app's codes.
- `number_of_codes` (Number) Number of redemptions the codes allow.
- `offer_code_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the custom code can be redeemed. Deactivating is permanent, so setting it back to `true` creates a new custom code. Defaults to `true`.
- `expiration_date` (String) Last day the code can be redeemed, e.g. `2026-12-31`. Unset means no expiration.

### Read-Only

- `created_date` (String) When the custom code was created.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom code.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code.spring
  identity = {
    offer_code_id = "9876543210"
    id            = "1234567890"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the custom code.
- `offer_code_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the offer code.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_subscription_offer_code_custom_code.spring 9876543210/1234567890
```
